title: skills.readiness params

sessionId.description: The session whose next run's set and workspace to check; leave out accountId and workspace.

accountId.description: With workspace and no sessionId: the account of a new session whose set to check.

workspace.description: With accountId and no sessionId: the workspace of a new session, where the checks run.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has; the harness never makes, moves or removes it outside a workspace root.

path.description: The worktree's directory, which the environment chose and made.

repository.description: The main checkout (or bare repository) the worktree was made from.

branch.description: The branch the worktree was made on; not read again when a run switches branch.

oneOf.description: A git worktree the environment made from a repository it has.

path.description: The scratch directory, under the data directory's scratch root.

oneOf.description: A scratch directory the environment made for the session that asked for it.

anyOf.description: A workspace of a kind a later environment records: read as a directory at its path.

kind.description: A kind this version does not know.

path.description: An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

names.description: The members to answer; every member of the set when absent. A name not in the set is left out.

items.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

refresh.description: Check again rather than answer what was checked in the last sixty seconds.

description: A session, whose next run's set is checked in its workspace; or an account and a workspace, where a new session's first run would be; with the names to answer and whether to check again.
